headline: Strait of Hormuz Crisis Deepens as Tanker Strike and Iran Threat Coincide
subheadline: Ukrainian deep strikes incinerated over 100,000 square meters of a Wildberries logistics hub in Tambov and forced the complete shutdown of Lukoil's major refinery.
lede: The Strait of Hormuz has emerged as the primary global threat vector after a tanker was hit by an unidentified projectile amid Iranian threats to keep the strategic waterway closed. US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated that military options remain entirely on the table to secure the passage. In the east, Russia launched a massive overnight combined aerial attack employing over 15 Shahed drones and ballistic missiles, which was met by Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian energy infrastructure.

sections.title: Russian Offensives Advance as Ukrainian Strikes Hit Energy
sections.body: Russia launched a large-scale combined aerial attack overnight, employing over 15 jet-powered Shahed drones, a ballistic missile toward Kyiv, Kh-59 cruise missiles, and cluster munitions against the Dnipropetrovsk region. On the ground, Russian forces claimed the capture of Pisarevka in the Sumy region and Nezhenka in Zaporizhzhia, while the 'Tsentr' group captured Annovka near Dobropillia. In retaliation, Ukrainian deep strikes successfully destroyed a massive Wildberries logistics hub in the Tambov region, burning over 100,000 square meters, and forced the complete shutdown of Lukoil's major Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez refinery. Meanwhile, the Russian 'Sever' group repelled a Ukrainian 68th Brigade counterattack near Sadki.

sections.title: Iran Threatens Hormuz Closure Amid Tanker Strike
sections.body: Iran and Oman reached understandings regarding the Strait of Hormuz, with Tehran threatening that the strait will remain closed unless the US accepts their conditions. A tanker was hit by an unidentified projectile in the strait, sparking a contained fire with all crew members safe and no environmental impact reported. US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth stated that the US does not rule out military options in the Strait of Hormuz under any circumstances. On a separate front, Israeli forces continued military operations in northern Gaza, destroying a Hamas position near the Al-Edd hospital and school and eliminating several militants.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous targeting of commercial shipping while Iran negotiates conditions for passage suggests either deliberate Iranian escalation or a lack of centralized control over IRGC elements. In Ukraine, the coordinated Russian escalation combining massed drone swarms with ground offensives on three axes indicates a broad front pressure campaign, while Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy infrastructure are inflicting significant economic damage. However, reported Patriot missile shortages and a Belarusian military buildup near the northern border represent critical escalation vectors and sustainability challenges for Ukrainian air defenses.
